page.layout: One printed page, a title page, set centred in a single block. The scan is rotated and the letters show through mirrored from the reverse side, so most lines cannot be read. Top block: a large heading line, then several smaller lines. Middle: a short line in large capitals, a small line, then a larger line. Lower middle: a few small lines. Bottom: a short imprint block of small lines. No margin notes.
page.notes: The page is a title page photographed at an angle and reversed. The letters seen through the paper are show-through from the other side and cannot be read reliably, so the lines are marked illegible. No page number, running head, catchword or signature is visible. The bottom imprint is too faint to read.
